user.title: Elli Charger Setup
user.description:
1. Open the [Elli login page]({authorization_url}) in a new browser tab and sign in.
2. After signing in, the browser tries to open a link starting with `com.elli.ios.emsp://` and shows an error. That is expected.
3. Copy that complete address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Elli Charger
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Elli authorization has expired.

1. Open the [Elli login page]({authorization_url}) in a new browser tab and sign in.
2. After signing in, the browser tries to open a link starting with `com.elli.ios.emsp://` and shows an error. That is expected.
3. Copy that complete address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Elli API
error.invalid_auth: Elli rejected the authorization. Please start the sign-in again.
error.invalid_callback: That does not look like a valid callback address. Copy the complete address starting with com.elli.ios.emsp://

abort.already_configured: This Elli account is already configured
